regions.label: Particle-text 'ZestSend' wordmark on canvas, rotating tagline 'Anonymously write together with end-to-end encryption'
Four underline-only digit inputs with hint 'Connect by entering any four digits that match someone else's.'
Icon buttons (Language, Settings, About) opening dialogs, and GitHub / author credit links

evidence.note: Four segmented single-digit inputs drawn as underline bars only (OTP-style code entry)

evidence.quote: Connect by entering any four digits that match someone else's.

patterns.rationale: Single 4-digit code entry with no submit button; likely auto-connects when filled. Whether it counts as a form vs a lone segmented field is a judgment call.

evidence.note: Group of 4 digit fields collected together as one connection code; no visible submit button

Language/Settings/About icon buttons; live check: Language opens a centered dialog with language selection list and close X, Settings opens centered 'Appearance' theme picker dialog over a blurred backdrop; Escape closes. Dialogs not open in capture.
Hovering icon buttons showed no tooltip
Settings button only opens a single theme-selection dialog, not a settings catalog; not visible in capture

structure.layout: single full-viewport centered splash: animated fluid canvas background, particle wordmark, rotating tagline, 4-digit code entry, icon row and credits; no header or scroll

aesthetics.typography: ui-sans-serif system stack throughout (bold 700 tagline with wide letter-spacing, semibold 600 hint and credits); wordmark is a particle/noise-rendered Helvetica-like sans drawn on canvas
aesthetics.typeScale: Canvas wordmark ~150px; tagline 48px/700 letter-spaced; hint 20px; credits 15px/600. Strong contrast between giant wordmark and small tracked microcopy

notes: Full-bleed animated WebGL-like fluid/smoke canvas in deep navy to cyan; wordmark rendered as dithered particle text on a canvas. Tagline rotates its middle phrase with a typing/erasing animation ('write together' + markdown icon, 'talk anytime' + phone, 'chat in real time' + chat bubble) while 'with end-to-end encryption' + lock stays in mint green. Code entry is 4 underline-bar digit slots with no submit button. Wide letter-spacing on all text. Settings dialog is a theme picker ('Midnight Drift', 'Glacier Blue', 'Signal Mint'...) with three-swatch color strips; Language dialog lists languages with pangram previews. Title says file transfer though tagline cycles through chat/call/writing.
